Why Manchester needs BeTranslated

Manchester has emerged as the UK’s fastest-growing regional tech hub, a transformation fuelled by the BBC’s relocation to Salford in 2011.

This move invigorated local digital and creative sectors, attracting businesses with its mix of cultural appeal and solid infrastructure.

As a trusted provider of translation services, we understand the importance of clear communication.

The city’s focus on sustainability, seen in companies like One+All, shows its focus on both enterprise and environmental responsibility.

With its thriving business scene and multicultural population, Manchester’s demand for professional translation services has never been higher.

As a specialist translation provider based in the UK, we deliver quick, accurate translations so communication runs smoothly.

Whether you need to translate documents in Manchester, Sheffield, Liverpool, or Leeds, our native translators understand the importance of every word.

With over 20 years of experience and a skilled team offering translations in various languages, we are here to support and contribute to the flourishing economy.

Translation services in Manchester

Certified and legal translation services in Manchester

The legal sector in Greater Manchester, home to over 500,000 people, requires strict precision so that written material is interpreted accurately in court proceedings.

In 2023, Greater Manchester’s diverse population included over 200 languages spoken, making accurate translations essential for clear understanting.

Our certified translators are highly experienced in legal translation services, so every document translation meets the highest standards.

In a diverse and bustling city like Manchester, UK, there is a significant demand for legal translation services due to its multicultural population and thriving business environment. Here are some examples of legal translations commonly required in Manchester:

Document translations

Personal Documents

  • Birth certificates
  • Marriage certificates
  • Divorce papers
  • Death certificates
  • Passports and identity cards

Educational Documents

  • Diplomas and transcripts
  • Academic certificates
  • Training certificates

Financial and Business Documents

  • Bank account statements
  • Credit history reports
  • Certificates of incorporation
  • Annual reports
  • Business contracts

Legal proceedings

  • Court orders and judgments
  • Summons and subpoenas
  • Expert reports
  • Affidavits
  • Lawsuits and legal decisions

Property and insurance

  • Property purchase contracts
  • Rental agreements
  • Insurance policies

Immigration and residency

  • Visa applications
  • Residency authorisation documents
  • Immigration-related websites

Employment

  • Employment contracts
  • Professional evaluations
  • Resumes and cover letters

Specialised legal documents

  • Patents
  • Intellectual property documents
  • Regulatory compliance documents
  • Foreign business regulations

These translations are often required to be certified, notarised, or sworn, depending on their intended use and the requirements of the receiving institution. 

For immigration purposes, certified translations of personal documents are frequently needed. 

In the legal sector of Greater Manchester, which is home to over 500,000 people, precise translation services are essential so that legal documents are interpreted accurately in court proceedings and other official contexts.

It’s important to note that in the UK, there isn’t a sworn translation system like in some other countries.

Instead, there are certified translations, notarised translations, and legal translations, each serving different purposes depending on the requirements of the receiving institution or authority.

Medical translation services

In Manchester’s healthcare sector, accurate translation services are required, particularly in areas like Longsight and Cheetham Hill, where up to 30% of residents are from multicultural backgrounds.

Our team provides expert medical translation services and is skilled in translating content into multiple languages, including Urdu, Arabic, Polish, and Cantonese, languages spoken by significant portions of Greater Manchester’s population. 

In the medical field, accurate translation of documents matters for communication between healthcare providers and patients, particularly in diverse communities.

Here are some examples of medical documents that often require translation:

Patient-related documents

Patient Information Forms
These forms collect essential personal and medical information from patients and need to be available in multiple languages so the details stay accurate and complete.

Consent Forms
These are critical for obtaining informed consent for medical procedures, so that patients fully understand the risks and benefits involved.

Medical History Questionnaires
Accurate translation of these questionnaires matters for proper diagnosis and treatment, as they provide healthcare providers with a comprehensive view of a patient’s medical background[3].

Clinical and administrative documents

Discharge Instructions
Patients need clear instructions in their native language to follow post-treatment care plans effectively.

Financial Responsibility Waivers
These documents outline the financial obligations of patients regarding their treatment and need to be understood clearly to avoid disputes.

Patient Rights and Responsibilities
This document informs patients about their rights within the healthcare system and their responsibilities, which supports transparency and trust.

Specialised medical documents

Clinical Trial Documents
Translation is essential so that participants understand the trial procedures, risks, and benefits, which is critical for ethical compliance.

Medical Equipment Manuals
These manuals need translation so that healthcare professionals can correctly operate medical devices, reducing the risk of misuse.

Pharmaceutical Documents
These include package inserts, patient information leaflets, and regulatory submission documents, which are needed for international drug development and distribution[1].

Additional important documents

Mental Status Examination Reports
These documents present the results of mental exams and require careful translation to avoid ambiguity.

Operative Reports
These reports detail the procedures and findings of surgical operations and require clear and concise translation.

These translations must be precise and often require certification so they meet legal standards and maintain patient safety. In the UK, healthcare providers must be particularly mindful of regulations regarding the provision of translated documents for limited English proficient (LEP) patients and comply with non-discrimination laws.

Technical translation services

Manchester is a growing hub for technology and engineering, contributing over £5 billion to the UK economy through its digital and tech industries. To support this growth, high-quality technical translation services are important for businesses expanding into global markets.

BeTranslated specialises in translating technical documents such as user manuals, software interfaces, and technical specifications into languages like German, Italian, Mandarin, and Japanese.

This is especially important as Manchester’s technology sector increasingly collaborates with markets in Europe and East Asia.

Our translators are experts in technical terminology, so complex content is translated accurately and easily understood by international audiences.

Accurate translation helps Manchester’s tech companies maintain their competitive edge globally while meeting the needs of their diverse, international customer base.

Multilingual SEO and localisation services

A strong online presence is essential for businesses looking to expand internationally.

Research shows that businesses offering multilingual websites can increase traffic by 47%, highlighting the value of localised content.

BeTranslated provides multilingual SEO and localisation services to help businesses in Greater Manchester reach diverse markets both locally and globally. 

Our SEO translation services optimise online content for multiple languages, including Russian, Turkish, Spanish, and Hindi, helping businesses improve visibility in search engines across different regions. 

We localise content for Manchester’s diverse population and global audiences to help businesses stay competitive.

Interpreting services in Manchester

Interpretation services are needed in various settings, including business meetings, healthcare appointments, and legal proceedings.

With more than 1 in 5 Manchester residents speaking a first language other than English, the demand for professional interpretation services has never been higher.

BeTranslated offers professional interpretation services for clients across Greater Manchester. 

Whether you require simultaneous interpretation for a large conference or consecutive interpretation for a medical consultation, our skilled interpreters provide accurate and timely language support.

We also offer British Sign Language (BSL) interpretation services to support the estimated 25,000 people in the UK who use BSL as their primary language.

Our services keep communication clear and effective, regardless of the language spoken.

Why choose BeTranslated?

At BeTranslated, we pride ourselves on our team of certified translators who bring industry-specific expertise to every project. 

We hold our work to a high standard, with quality assurance processes in place to keep translations accurate. 

Efficiency matters, which is why our project management team streamlines processes to deliver translations on time. 

Recognising Manchester’s diverse population, we offer services that cater to the needs of different communities and businesses. 

Our proficiency in a wide range of languages allows us to serve clients from all corners of the globe, making us well placed to serve Manchester’s multicultural communities.

Get started with BeTranslated

Ready to experience top-quality, personalised, and professional translation services? 

  • Get a free, no-obligation quote here
  • Email us at global@betranslated.com
  • Call us at (+44) 20 3026 9848

At BeTranslated, we help businesses communicate clearly with people who speak other languages in Manchester’s dynamic business environment.
